families.rule_focus: Use a necessary term without hiding a simple action in an empty service construction.

cases.brief: A repair note for optics technicians; the focal length is the required measurement.
cases.text: Measure the focal length before adjusting the fictional instrument.
alternatives: Other precise descriptions of the same measurement

cases.brief: A direct instruction to switch off a fictional lamp.
cases.text: Carry out the implementation of the deactivation of the lamp.
properties: State the switching-off action directly without losing its object

families.rule_focus: Distinguish an audience-known abbreviation from an unexplained new acronym.

cases.brief: A lab note for researchers who already use the abbreviation LED.
cases.text: Check the LED before replacing the battery.
alternatives: An equally precise expanded name if the brief asks for it

cases.brief: A public visitor note; NGP is a new fictional name meaning night gate permit.
cases.text: Bring your NGP to the night entrance.

families.rule_focus: Distinguish ordinary idiom, accidental corruption and intentional wordplay.

cases.brief: Ordinary English narration with the familiar expression about an obvious hidden problem.
cases.text: There was an elephant in the room, and nobody mentioned it.
properties: Preserve the meaning of the shared unspoken problem

cases.brief: An ordinary proverb is intended; no wordplay is requested.
cases.text: Do not count your ladders before they hatch.
properties: Repair the accidental mismatch while preserving the warning against premature certainty

cases.brief: In this fictional comedy, a carpenter deliberately twists the proverb with ladders; the joke is intentional.
cases.text: Do not count your ladders before they hatch.

controls: Pin the previous and candidate contexts before running; retain every attempt; use new reserve material after development.
